name: Da Hanul
source:
The protagonist of this tale, a senior high-schooler who ended up with two daughters.
After a fateful series of events following the death of his parents in accident four years ago, he became the father of two cute children named Nuri and Sora.
He is very frail, and used to be chased around by animals as if he was food, but now he is chased around by both animals and children as if he was a toy.
He is the head of the house, exausted everyday by Sora, his mature eldest, and Nuri, a gluttonous troublemaker.
He lives a tough life as a single parent, but tries hard to guide the development of his children, as he grows to become a proper father.

[From in-game profile]
